## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

## Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

- When planning the use of hazardous substances thefollowinghierarchy of control is tobe used:
- Elimination
- Substitution
- Provision of engineering controls
- Administrative controls(procedures,training)
- Use of PPE
- Stores for hazardous substances are to be well-ventilated,protected from the elements,clear of any ignition sources and at least 10m from any water source.They are to be bund to prevent leaks and spills contaminating the surrounding area and are to be secured to prevent unauthorized use. Suitable signs are to be displayed warning personnel of the hazards.
- Substances that are not compatible are not to be stored together such as flammable gas and oxidizing agents.
- An inventory of MSDS is to be readily available and containers used for storing, handling, transporting and dispensing hazardous substance are to be suitable for use and have a label showing it contents and quantities.
- A separate routinely reviewed and updated Inventory of stored substances (a minimum of name, hazard, and quantity) should also be held for each container in the event that information requires to be provided to the Civil Defense Department or others in the event of an emergency.
- Decanting hazardous liquids into plastic bottles is prohibited.
- Spill kits are to be positioned in areas where hazardous substances are stored and used and any leaks or spills are to be cleaned up immediately. Containers outside bund areas are to be placed on drip trays and when dispensing, funnels or jugs are to be used.
- Fire extinguishers are tobe available at storage areas andwhere hazardous substances are in use.
- Eating, drinking and smoking are prohibited in areas where hazardous substances are in use.
- PPE must only bc providcd as a last resort and where provided it must provide suitable protection against the hazard the individual may be exposed to.
- Respiratory protective equipment (RPE) will be required in addition to PPE where there is a risk from fumes, dusts, vapors and these cannot be controlled by engineering controls or where engineering controls do not offer sufficient protection.
- A health surveillance program is to be established for personnel who have been exposed to hazardous substances and records are to be maintained.
- Where there is a risk to personnel from hazardous substances in workplaces a surveillance program is to be implemented. Equipmcnt uscd is to be suitable, be calibrated and operated by a competent person. A record of all surveillance tests and results is to be retained.
- Personnel are to be provided instruction,information and training on hazardous substances if they are likely touse or come in contact with them or their by-products e.g.fumesfrom welding.
